details: After the update today performance has gotten so much worse, the VRChat is not usable anymore for me. I am on an 58000X3D/4090 system and typically I get frametimes around 4-7ms when alone in my home world. After the update today those suddenly spiked to ~50. Sometimes it works a few seconds normally after restarting the client, but the problem is 100% reproduceable. Other games run fine of course, benchmarks produce values typically for such a setup. I couldn't find any other bug report on this, but I heard on discord that other people have similar problems, too - although much less frequent. I did some extensive debugging over the weekend. I changed the GPU to a 3090 and tried older drivers, changed from Steam VR beta to release, tried disabling various services, etc. - no avail. The only workaround I have found so far: After removing the graphics drivers with DDU, rebooting and reinstalling them it seem to work - If I do not reboot again after installing the drivers. Once I reboot, the problem returns! Headset is Valve Index. I also tried using my Quest 2 with Virtual Desktop - in this case the problem doesn't seem to occure.
title: Performance suddenly terrible with build 9741554
